requirements_summary: Primary need: embeddings-backed semantic search for customer support KB. Must support: 1) sub-50ms 95th percentile for top-k retrieval in US region under steady traffic (~200-500 QPS), 2) nightly bulk embedding pipeline for ~2M documents with incremental upserts, 3) deterministic routing/fallback to lower-cost model for non-critical queries, 4) SSO + audit logs + EU data residency for a subset of data.
poc_scope: Phase 1 (hosted): validate retrieval latency and embedding quality on 50k-sample KB
Phase 2 (bulk): run nightly bulk embedding using Redwood ingestion + Pinecone connector on a 200k subset
Phase 3 (dedicated): spin up dedicated GPU pool for peak hour tests and compare cost/perf vs hosted
Success metrics: 95th pctl latency <50ms for top-3, vector ingestion throughput >= 150k embeddings/hour during batch window, embedding cosine similarity match rate > baseline by 4%
technical_criteria: API ergonomics: SDK support for Python + Node, streaming responses for rerank flow
Vector DB: managed connector to Pinecone + option to export bulk embeddings to S3
Batch: support for concurrent workers and resumable upserts; hooks for Airflow
Observability: per-route token cost, per-request latency histogram, tracing hooks
Fallbacks: model routing policies and automatic downgrade to smaller quantized model under capacity pressure
pricing_needs: Need clear comparison: hosted monthly vs dedicated reserved capacity (12mo commit). Want modeling for: baseline 500k embeddings/month + nightly 1.8M doc re-embed seasonally. Include burst pricing and preemptible capacity options.
